problem: A deck contains $10$ cards labeled with the numbers $4$, $7$, $10,…,31.$ If one card is randomly drawn from the deck, what is its expected value?

activity_context.topic_title: Expected Values of Discrete Random Variables

feedback.problem: You have a stack of five cards labeled $1$ through $5.$ If one card is randomly drawn, what is its expected value?
feedback.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Let $X$ be the label on a randomly drawn card. Then the support is $S={1,2,3,4,5},$ and the corresponding probabilities are all $\frac{1}{5}:$

$$
f(1)=f(2)=…=f(5)=\frac{1}{5}
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+…+5\cdot f(5) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{5})+2(\frac{1}{5})+…+5(\frac{1}{5}) \\  & =\frac{1}{5}+\frac{2}{5}+…+\frac{5}{5} \\  & =\frac{1+2+3+4+5}{5} \\  & =\frac{15}{5} \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
